newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks slip, Sindicato Antioqueno active.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks slip, Sindicato Antioqueno active.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed lower Friday amid lively trading of companies in the powerful industrial conglomerate Sindicato Antioqueno.
Bogota's IBB index fell 1.12 percent to 842.66 on trading of shares worth 2.77 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index slipped 0.81 percent to 13,255.26 on volume of 1.9 billion pesos.

"There were a number of deals in Sindicato Antioqueno. These appear to have been pre-arranged and were conducted by the conglomerate's own brokerage Suvalor. I don't think foreign funds snapped up the shares," one Bogota broker said.

More than 1.3 billion pesos worth of shares in cement manufacturer Cementos Argos shares changed hands on the Bogota exchange, as its share price dropped 0.92 percent to 5,350. Cementos Argos is one of Sindicato Antioqueo's bluechip companies.
Cigarette maker Coltabaco, part of the same conglomerate, was unchanged at 3,000 on volume of 1.09 billion pesos.

"The rapid rise of Wall Street drew the attention of most foreign funds, which are now waiting for the prices of Colombian stocks to settle after third-quarter results before they move in again,'' a second Bogota broker said.
